documents.text: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Rice is connected to varieties ADT 36, CO 51 and Bhavani. ADT 36 is linked to Kuruvai and CO 51 to Samba in this illustrative demo.
ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Stem borer and leaf folder are linked to rice as pests in this illustrative demo. Field monitoring is linked to stem borer. This is not a pest-control recommendation.
ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Clay loam soil and water management are connected to rice in this illustrative demo. This is not a cultivation recommendation.
ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Maize is linked to fall armyworm and Rabi. Pheromone traps are linked to monitoring fall armyworm in this illustrative demo.
ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Tomato is linked to fruit borer and Rabi in this illustrative demo.
ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA: Rice is linked to Kuruvai and Samba. Maize and tomato are linked to Rabi in this illustrative demo.
